messages.content: Classify this patient comment: The nurse pulled up a chair, heard all my questions, and explained each step without rushing me.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The nurse listened to the patient's questions and explained the care steps patiently.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I felt dismissed when the night nurse rolled her eyes and talked over me whenever I tried to describe my concern.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The nurse's eye-rolling and interruptions show disrespectful, inattentive communication.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The nurse was kind, but the explanation of what would happen before the test left me more confused than before.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The central issue is the nurse's unclear explanation before the test despite a kind manner.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: my nurse actually listened when i said i was scared and didnt make me feel silly
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The patient highlights that the nurse listened and responded respectfully to their fear.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Every shift change brought a new nurse, yet each one introduced themselves and checked that I understood the plan.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The nurses consistently introduced themselves and verified the patient's understanding of the plan.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Asked a simple question about the morning procedure and the nurse said, ask the doctor, then walked away.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The nurse dismissed the patient's question and ended the interaction without helping.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The room was chilly, but what upset me was the nurse speaking about me as if I was not there.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The decisive complaint is the nurse's disrespectful communication in the patient's presence; room temperature is incidental.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: Nurse explained things ok I guess.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The brief comment evaluates how the nurse explained care, though the assessment is vague.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: tbh the RN remembered what mattered to me and repeated the instructions slowly when I asked.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The RN respected the patient's priorities and adapted the explanation when asked.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The doctor drew a quick diagram of the procedure and paused until both my partner and I understood it.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The doctor used a diagram and checked understanding while explaining the procedure.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: My physician stared at the computer, interrupted every answer, and left before I could ask about the test results.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The physician interrupted the patient and did not allow questions about the results.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The specialist used so much jargon that I nodded along even though I had no idea what the diagnosis meant.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The specialist's jargon left the patient unable to understand the diagnosis.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: doc came back later bc he realized I still had questions and went over the scan again
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The doctor recognized unanswered questions and returned to explain the scan again.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I appreciated that the hospitalist admitted what she did not know and explained when the next update would come.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The hospitalist communicated uncertainty honestly and set expectations for an update.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The doctor was polite and the food was cold, but I still never got a clear answer about why another test was needed.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The supported central concern is the doctor's unclear explanation for an additional test; food is outside the themes.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: He gave me an update, sort of, but it was too quick to follow.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The comment appears to describe a doctor's rushed update, although the speaker and details are incomplete.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: The surgeon listened carefully to my concerns about the operation even while the unit around us was busy.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The surgeon's attentive listening is the specific experience being praised.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I asked what the lab numbers meant and the doctor translated them into everyday language without being condescending.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The doctor clearly and respectfully explained the laboratory results.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I pressed the call button after feeling unsteady, and someone was beside me within two minutes.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"Staff responded promptly after the patient used the call button for help.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Needed help changing position and waited so long that I finally gave up asking.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The complaint centers on a prolonged lack of response to a request for positioning help.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The nurse was friendly when she arrived, but my call light blinked for half an hour before anyone came.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The decisive issue is the half-hour wait after using the call light, not the nurse's manner.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: hit the button for bathroom help twice n nobody showed til it was almost too late
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The patient reports repeated unanswered requests for timely bathroom assistance.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: When I requested my prescribed pain medicine, it took nearly fifty minutes to reach me even though its purpose had been explained.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The medicine explanation was adequate; the central complaint is the delay after requesting it.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: Staff usually came eventually.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The vague statement most directly concerns whether staff responded, but gives little detail about timeliness.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: I dropped my water cup, called out, and a technician quickly brought water and cleaned the spill.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"A technician promptly answered the request and addressed the immediate need.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The unit looked organized, yet nobody answered when I asked for assistance reaching my glasses.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The supported issue is the unanswered request for help reaching an item; the unit's appearance is secondary.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: My request for an extra blanket was handled right away, which mattered because the room felt freezing.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The patient specifically praises the immediate response to a request for a blanket.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Before starting the new tablet, the pharmacist explained why it was added and the side effects I should report.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"The patient received a clear explanation of a new medicine's purpose and possible side effects.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: A nurse handed me an unfamiliar capsule during the stay and only said it was on the list.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"An unfamiliar medicine was given during the stay without explaining its purpose.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: They told me the name of the injection but not what reactions might happen afterward.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"The injection was identified, but potential side effects were not explained.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: new med showed up at breakfast, no one sed why i needed it
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"A new medicine was given during the hospital stay without its purpose being explained.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The doctor seemed rushed, but she did clearly explain what the new medication was for before I took it.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"The most specific issue is the doctor's explanation of a new medicine before administration.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: I think somebody mentioned the pill, maybe.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"The fragment appears to concern an explanation of a pill, but it is too vague to establish what was communicated.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: Even with several interruptions, the nurse returned and reviewed both the reason for the new drug and its common effects.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"The nurse completed an explanation of the new drug's purpose and common effects.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I waited for the antibiotic, but my bigger concern was that nobody would tell me why it had been changed.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"Although a wait is mentioned, the patient identifies the missing explanation for the changed medicine as the main concern.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: The whiteboard listed a new medicine, and staff checked that I understood its purpose before the first dose.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"Staff verified understanding of the new medicine's purpose before giving it.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: My discharge sheet clearly listed the symptoms that meant I should call the clinic and those that meant return immediately.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The discharge material clearly provided warning signs and when to seek different levels of help.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I left with no instructions about which changes in my condition should make me contact anyone.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The patient was not told which warning signs should prompt contact after discharge.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The paperwork explained wound care but never said when redness or drainage became urgent.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The missing information is when specific post-discharge symptoms require urgent help.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: papers said monitor symptoms but didnt say what symptoms or who 2 call
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The discharge papers lacked concrete warning signs and contact instructions.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: They reviewed my ride home and also gave a precise number to call if the fever returned; the warning guidance was especially helpful.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The patient emphasizes concrete guidance about a warning sign and whom to call after discharge.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: There may have been something about calling later.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The fragment may refer to post-discharge contact guidance, but it does not identify the circumstances or instructions.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: Before I left, staff highlighted exactly when shortness of breath should send me back for care.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"Staff provided a specific warning sign and explained when the patient should return for care.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The nurse was warm and respectful at checkout, but the written instructions omitted any signs of trouble to watch for.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"Despite positive nurse communication, the decisive issue is missing warning-sign information after discharge.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: I knew how to change the dressing, yet no one explained when a change in its appearance required a call.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The patient knew the care task but lacked instructions about warning signs requiring contact.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The team practiced the stairs with me and adjusted the home plan after learning my bedroom is upstairs.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The discharge plan was adapted to the patient's home layout and ability to manage stairs.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: They sent me home with equipment I could not lift and never asked whether anyone would be there to help.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The plan ignored the patient's physical ability and available help at home.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I received detailed papers, but the schedule assumed I could drive to appointments even though I cannot drive.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"Despite detailed information, the transition plan did not account for the patient's transportation limitation.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: got home with 4 meds and no clue which old one i was supposed to stop
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The patient was not prepared to manage old and take-home medicines after leaving the hospital.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: A therapist watched me use the walker, asked about my narrow hallway, and found an approach I could manage alone.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The team considered the patient's home environment and ability to manage mobility independently.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Home felt harder than they made it sound.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The vague complaint suggests the patient was not adequately prepared to manage after discharge.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: They explained every bottle's purpose and made a simple chart I could follow once I was back home.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The team prepared the patient to understand and manage take-home medicines.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The discharge time changed twice, but the real problem was that the plan expected me to pay for supplies I could not afford.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The central issue is a discharge plan that ignored the patient's financial ability to obtain needed supplies.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: My caregiver joined by phone, demonstrated the routine back to the nurse, and left feeling ready to help me.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The transition process included the caregiver and verified readiness to support care at home.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Housekeeping wiped the counters and changed the linens daily; the room always felt fresh.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"The patient specifically praises daily surface cleaning, fresh linens, and room cleanliness.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Sticky spots remained on the floor for my entire stay even after I pointed them out.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"Persistent sticky floor spots are a direct room-cleanliness concern.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The bathroom smelled bad and the waste bin overflowed by the second evening.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"Bathroom odor and an overflowing waste bin indicate poor cleanliness.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: sheets had crumbs when i arrived but they swapped them fast after i asked
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"The comment centers on dirty bedding at arrival, although staff corrected it promptly.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: The television was loud next door, yet the stained sink and dusty tray bothered me much more.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"The patient identifies the stained sink and dusty tray as the primary concern over secondary noise.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: It could have been cleaner.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"The comment indicates dissatisfaction with cleanliness but gives no specific surface or condition.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: Someone removed trash often, and both the shower and toilet were spotless whenever I used them.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"Frequent trash removal and spotless bathroom fixtures are clear positive cleanliness feedback.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: A spill near the doorway stayed there through two shift changes and made the room feel neglected.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"An unattended spill persisting through multiple shifts is a specific cleanliness problem.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The cleaning worker introduced herself and did a thorough job on the room and bathroom.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"The feedback directly praises thorough cleaning of the patient room and bathroom.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Nights were peaceful, with alarms addressed quickly and hallway voices kept low.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"The patient praises low hallway voices and promptly silenced alarms at night.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Staff held a loud conversation outside my door around midnight and woke me just after I fell asleep.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"A late-night staff conversation outside the room disrupted the patient's sleep.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Beeping from an unattended monitor continued for hours overnight.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Prolonged monitor beeping overnight is a direct nighttime noise complaint.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: carts kept clanking past my door @ 3 am, couldnt stay asleep
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Clanking carts at 3 a.m. repeatedly interrupted the patient's sleep.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The room was very clean, but the roommate's television played all night and that was the difficult part.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"The patient identifies the all-night television noise as the main problem despite positive cleanliness.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: Not exactly restful.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"The comment weakly suggests a disturbance to rest, but it does not identify a noise source.","confidence":"low"}
Classify this patient comment: The unit dimmed lights and reduced overhead announcements after evening hours, which made sleep possible.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Reduced evening announcements contributed to a quiet environment that supported sleep.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Doors slammed repeatedly during the night, though daytime noise was reasonable.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Repeated door slamming at night is the specific disturbance described.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: My nurse explained the checks well, but each overnight check included loud voices that woke the whole room.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Although nurse communication was good, the recurring loud voices during overnight checks were the central complaint.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: The meals arrived lukewarm, and the vegetarian choices were the same every day.
{"label":"other","rationale":"Food temperature and menu variety are outside the supported feedback themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Billing sent three different totals and I still cannot tell what insurance covered.
{"label":"other","rationale":"The comment concerns billing and insurance statements, which are outside the supported themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The mattress sagged in the middle and made it impossible to get comfortable.
{"label":"other","rationale":"Bed comfort is not one of the supported classification themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: visitor hours made no sense n my family was turned away after driving a long way
{"label":"other","rationale":"The complaint is about visitor policy, which falls outside the supported themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I would give the hospital four stars and probably recommend it.
{"label":"other","rationale":"An overall rating and recommendation without a supported specific experience belongs in other.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Admission took forever because the same forms had to be entered at two desks.
{"label":"other","rationale":"The feedback concerns the admission process and duplicate paperwork, not a supported theme.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Wi-Fi dropped every few minutes, so I could not video call my family.
{"label":"other","rationale":"Hospital Wi-Fi service is outside the supported patient-experience themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Everyone was wonderful.
{"label":"other","rationale":"The praise is nonspecific and does not identify any supported experience.","confidence":"low"}
